name: Chicken Fried Rice
instructions: Cook the rice and set it aside. Cut the chicken and carrot into small pieces. Cook the chicken in a pan until fully cooked. Add the carrot and cook until soft. Add the egg and stir. Add the rice and soy sauce. Mix everything together and serve.

name: Tomato Egg Stir Fry
instructions: Wash and cut the tomatoes into pieces. Beat the eggs in a bowl. Heat oil in a pan and cook the eggs. Remove the eggs and cook the tomatoes until soft. Add the eggs back to the pan. Season with salt and serve.

name: Garlic Butter Pasta
instructions: Boil the pasta according to the package instructions. Melt butter in a pan and add chopped garlic. Cook until fragrant. Add the cooked pasta and mix well. Sprinkle cheese on top and serve.

name: Chicken Vegetable Soup
instructions: Cut the chicken and vegetables into small pieces. Put the chicken in a pot with water and bring to a boil. Add the carrot, potato, and onion. Simmer until the chicken is fully cooked and the vegetables are soft. Add salt and serve.

name: Egg Fried Rice
instructions: Beat the eggs in a bowl. Heat oil in a pan and scramble the eggs. Add cooked rice and stir well. Add soy sauce and chopped green onion. Cook for a few minutes and serve.

name: Tomato Pasta
instructions: Boil the pasta until tender. Heat olive oil in a pan and cook chopped garlic. Add chopped tomatoes and cook until they form a sauce. Add the pasta and mix well. Serve warm.

name: Potato Omelette
instructions: Peel and slice the potato. Chop the onion. Cook the potato and onion in a pan until soft. Beat the eggs with salt and pour them into the pan. Cook until the eggs are set. Flip carefully and serve.

name: Chicken Salad
instructions: Cook the chicken thoroughly and let it cool. Wash and chop the lettuce, tomato, and cucumber. Cut the chicken into small pieces. Combine everything in a bowl and mix well.

name: Vegetable Stir Fry
instructions: Wash and cut the broccoli and carrot. Heat oil in a pan and add chopped garlic. Add the vegetables and stir fry until tender. Add soy sauce and mix well. Serve warm.

name: Cheese Omelette
instructions: Beat the eggs with milk. Melt butter in a pan. Pour in the egg mixture and cook over medium heat. Add cheese when the eggs begin to set. Fold the omelette and cook until the cheese melts.

name: Spaghetti Bolognese
instructions: Boil the spaghetti until tender. Heat olive oil in a pan and cook chopped onion and garlic until soft. Add the ground beef and cook until browned. Add chopped tomatoes and simmer for 20 minutes. Serve the sauce over the spaghetti.

name: Grilled Cheese Sandwich
instructions: Butter one side of each slice of bread. Place cheese between the slices with the buttered sides facing out. Cook in a pan over medium heat until golden brown on both sides and the cheese is melted. Serve hot.

name: Mashed Potatoes
instructions: Peel and cut the potatoes into chunks. Boil in salted water until soft. Drain the water. Mash the potatoes with butter and milk until smooth. Season with salt and serve.

name: Caesar Salad
instructions: Cut the bread into cubes and toast with olive oil and garlic until crunchy. Wash and chop the lettuce. Toss the lettuce with olive oil and lemon juice. Add the croutons and top with parmesan cheese.

name: Beef Burger
instructions: Season the ground beef with salt and shape into patties. Cook the patties in a pan until fully cooked. Add cheese on top and let it melt. Toast the buns lightly. Assemble the burger with the patty, lettuce, and sliced tomato.

name: Pancakes
instructions: Mix the flour, sugar, and baking powder in a bowl. Add milk and egg and stir until smooth. Melt butter in a pan over medium heat. Pour in the batter and cook until bubbles form. Flip and cook until golden brown.

name: Tomato Soup
instructions: Melt butter in a pot and cook chopped onion and garlic until soft. Add chopped tomatoes and a cup of water. Simmer for 20 minutes. Blend until smooth. Season with salt and serve hot.

name: Baked Chicken with Potatoes
instructions: Heat the oven to 200C. Cut the potatoes into chunks and place in a baking dish with the chicken. Drizzle with olive oil and add chopped garlic and salt. Bake for 40 minutes until the chicken is fully cooked and the potatoes are golden.

name: Macaroni and Cheese
instructions: Boil the macaroni until tender and drain. Melt butter in a pot and stir in flour. Slowly add milk and stir until thickened. Add cheese and stir until melted. Mix in the macaroni and serve.

name: French Toast
instructions: Beat the eggs with milk and cinnamon in a bowl. Dip each slice of bread into the mixture. Melt butter in a pan over medium heat. Cook the bread until golden brown on both sides. Serve warm.

name: Garlic Mushroom Steak
instructions: Season the steak with salt. Cook in a hot pan for 3 to 5 minutes per side. Remove and let rest. Melt butter in the same pan and cook sliced mushrooms and garlic until soft. Pour over the steak and serve.

name: Caprese Salad
instructions: Slice the tomatoes and mozzarella. Arrange them in alternating layers on a plate. Add basil leaves on top. Drizzle with olive oil and sprinkle with salt.

name: Creamy Mushroom Pasta
instructions: Boil the pasta until tender. Melt butter in a pan and cook sliced mushrooms and garlic until soft. Add cream and simmer for a few minutes. Add cheese and the cooked pasta. Mix well and serve.

name: Beef Stew
instructions: Cut the beef and vegetables into chunks. Brown the beef in a pot. Add the onion, carrot, potato, and enough water to cover. Simmer for 1.5 to 2 hours until the beef is tender. Season with salt and serve.

name: Scrambled Eggs on Toast
instructions: Beat the eggs with milk and salt. Melt butter in a pan over low heat. Add the eggs and stir gently until softly set. Toast the bread and serve the eggs on top.
